deriveddata-reuse.what: Per-runner build state kept between runs: an owned Mac's admission DerivedData (scripts/ci/owned_build_state.py), the nightly DerivedData seed (scripts/ci/seed_derived_data.py), the scheme and Release compiles' worker-local tree, a tour's claimed warm slot (media_tag_lock.py), the Chief's per-runner cargo target, or a controller warm slot's DerivedData generation

spm-shared.what: The per-mini SwiftPM scratch shared across a mini's slots, so a job resolves and builds packages from what another slot already fetched and built

ssd-cas.what: glaeda's fleet compiler-CAS node on each owned mini (fleet-cas socket and settings under /Users/Shared/cmux-build-fleet/xcode); its store moves to the controller mini's SSD

dev-cas.what: The DEV CAS seed store named by vars.CMUX_NEXT_DEV_CAS_URL (scripts/cmux-next/dev_cas_seed.py)

actions-cache.what: actions/cache (and the actions built on it: Swatinem/rust-cache, .github/actions/cache-restore, Blacksmith sticky disks), served by Blacksmith's cache on its runners

linux-pool-warm.what: The controller's warm Linux pool lanes (cmux-ci compile-check --app, cmux-next-swift-check)

product-reuse.what: A green compile receipt or built product for the same tree, reused instead of compiled again (scripts/ci/reuse_app_host_products.py, nightly_release_product_reuse.py, dev_release_product_reuse.py, reuse_release_product.py, job_reuse.py)
